name: codex-pet
description: Your Codex pet, living above the Claude Code prompt: it works while Claude works, waits when you are needed, and celebrates when a turn is done.

pet.title: Pet
pet.description: Which pet to show: auto (an installed Codex pet, else the Codex app's own, else the bundled Blob), or a pet's id as /pet list names it. /pet use <id> overrides this.

size.title: Size
size.description: How large the pet is drawn. Desktop: 72, 104 or 156 pixels tall. A terminal picture: 4, 6 or 9 rows. Terminal blocks: 7 rows for small, 13 otherwise.

animation.title: Animation
animation.description: lively: always moving. calm: a pet that is idle, waiting or up for review rests between movements. still: one frame a mood.

label.title: Label
label.description: Show the pet's name and what it is doing beside it.

align.title: Position
align.description: Where the pet stands in the band above the prompt.

terminalCells.title: Terminal cell shape
terminalCells.description: For the picture and blocks in a terminal. standard: its character cells are about twice as tall as they are wide. tall: they are taller than that (roomy line spacing), which makes the pet look stretched upward; this draws it wider to compensate.

terminalStyle.title: In a terminal
terminalStyle.description: auto: the pet's own picture where the terminal shows images (kitty, Ghostty), and a small face of characters elsewhere. picture: always try the picture. face: always the face. blocks: the pet drawn in coarse blocks of color.
